high_level_description: This image is an illustration of a cricket locker room scene. The central focus is on a cricket jersey hanging on a hook inside the locker. The jersey is dark blue with the word "INDIA" written across the back in orange letters, and the number "75" is prominently displayed below it in large orange numerals. The collar of the jersey features a colorful design with horizontal stripes in green, white, red, and blue. To the left of the jersey, there is a blue cricket bag with a yellow handle, suggesting that it contains equipment or personal items for the player.
